description: 100 concepts from the fresh 2015-2017 OpenAlex onset cohort (stratified by analysis group x onset year, restricted to concepts with OPEN_home, OPEN_all, the O2r_m50 outcome and frozen predictions). Each row has the six raw ego-network components for the ALL and HOME builds, the frozen OPEN scores, the B5 + reach covariates, LLM concept type/generic/level, the O2r_m50 outcome and the frozen B5 / B5+OPEN_home predictions.
